question: What paradoxical condition affects even the wise at the point of nectar?
premises: The location is the tip of nectar.
There is contact with the foremost essence of fluid.
Even a wise person is described as burning.
inference: Even the wise may experience a burning condition at the nectar point despite its essence.
uncertainties: The imagery of burning at the nectar point is metaphorically dense.
plain_english: Even the wise person burns at the tip of nectar, touched by the foremost essence of its fluid.
